decisions.reason: The stacking tray extends the core display business at low incremental cost, and with turnover growing and the firm hiring and investing, there is no shortfall to trigger search and enough slack to keep it.

The online portal is distant from the core offer and its results are uncertain, but it supports customer collaboration and the firm's digital and information-security direction, so slack allows it to be carried for now.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 puts the packaging display above aspirations and gives it external legitimacy, so dropping it makes no sense.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the core business and featured on its own page, so it fits the display focus and shows no shortfall.
The counter display is a standard, low-risk extension of the core range, featured prominently, and needs no problemistic search.
The freestanding information display uses existing production and design capabilities at little extra cost, and the growing firm has the slack to keep it.
